notes:
• Continue Watching and Next Episode cards show the episode's own picture instead of the show's artwork
• Trakt stays linked more reliably: each sign-in renewal is sent only once and saved straight away
• Updating ValFlix waits for a Trakt renewal in progress to finish first, so an update can't lose your Trakt link
• If Trakt ends a sign-in, ValFlix shows "Sign-in expired" once and stops asking Trakt until you link it again
